notes.text: HTTP clients make REST calls to CHAT (FastAPI); Provider push sends provider events to WEBHOOK (Flask); web (Next.js 14) makes REST calls to INTERACTION (Flask).

CHAT (FastAPI) and INTERACTION (Flask) enqueue SQS tasks and make API calls to LLM providers; CHAT (FastAPI) also reads PostgreSQL; INTERACTION (Flask) also reads + writes PostgreSQL and makes API calls to CRM + workspace APIs.
Temporal workflows read PostgreSQL and enqueue SQS tasks.
